name: Beatriz Oliveira
bio:
Beatriz Oliveira's path to motorsport security was unconventional. After a brief stint in law enforcement, Beatriz realized her skills in investigation and risk assessment could be applied to the high-stakes world of racing. She started as a junior security officer at a small rally team, quickly proving her worth by identifying and resolving several critical security vulnerabilities. Her sharp eye for detail and no-nonsense approach earned her a reputation for getting things done.

At Brasil Racing, Beatriz is responsible for overseeing all security protocols, from trackside safety to data protection. She takes a proactive approach, constantly assessing potential threats and implementing preventative measures. Her demanding nature stems from a deep commitment to ensuring the safety and integrity of the team's operations. She is known for her unwavering dedication and her willingness to go the extra mile to protect her team.

physical.hairStyle: Tightly braided and pulled back into a practical bun.
physical.description: Beatriz is of medium height with a lean, athletic build, reflecting her active lifestyle.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously documenting everything.
Has a habit of tapping her fingers on surfaces when deep in thought.
Insists on conducting security briefings in a specific order, regardless of the agenda.
